name: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de ~Maihitoyo~
original_name: 遙かなる時空の中で　舞一夜
source: Based on the movie of the same name, this game is a re-telling of the original Harukanaru Toki no Naka De 1, where the story is based in a different setting and with a new character added.
translation: Based on the movie of the same name, this game is a re-telling of the original Harukanaru Toki no Naka De 1, where the story is based in a different setting and with a new character added.
